Start with these

Nine years in, the fish taco has been called the best in Nevada five years running. Here is where a first visit usually goes.

  1. 01

    Bajamar Fish Taco

    The one the awards are about. Battered or grilled, cabbage, chipotle aioli, a house salsa.

  2. 02

    Gobernador Taco

    Griddled shrimp and melted cheese. Order it with the octopus if you are feeling it.

  3. 03

    Tsunami Tostada

    Mixed seafood piled on a crisp tostada. The house move for a table to share.

A family, a griddle, and Baja

Bajamar is a Puchi family operation. They opened the first location on Las Vegas Blvd in 2017 with one idea: bring the seafood you eat on the Baja coast to Las Vegas and keep it casual.

The concept the family describes is a Baja California surf shack. Bright food, dark walls, string lights, the game on the TVs, a griddle you can watch from the counter. Nothing upscale on purpose. You come in, you order at the register, you get a plate of something that tastes like the ocean.

Nine years later there are locations across the valley and the fish taco has been named best in Nevada five years running, by the family's count. The newest room is the one on S Rainbow Blvd, opened in 2026 for the southwest side.

Hillside shoot · the counter and the griddle

What stays the same at every location

Seafood first

Fish, shrimp, octopus, marlin, calamari. The menu is built around what comes out of the water, not around a protein swap.

A griddle you can watch

The Gobernador and the chicharrones come off an open flat-top a few feet from where you order.

A family operation

Run by the Puchis since 2017. Same recipes and the same salsas at the new room on Rainbow.

The Rainbow spot

7960 S Rainbow Blvd, Ste 8000A, Las Vegas, NV 89139. Southwest valley, near the 215 Beltway. This is the newest Bajamar room.

The room

A strip-mall bay done up as a surf shack: reclaimed-wood tables, black metal chairs, a painted octopus on the wall, string lights, a real board mounted up high, and TVs with the game. An open kitchen runs along one side so you can watch your plate come together. Bright, loud, family and game-day friendly.
